items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: She and I are friends, you know, but not close.

ctx.x: The girl that married Bounce, Judy, she used to work up there at Hopper, and he had eyes for her. So she says, 'I'll go out with you if you'll go to Bradley's.' He says, 'Where is Bradley's?' She says, 'I'll show you.' So she took him down to Bradley's and invited me over to the table, and I sat down next to her. Here I am sitting with Placido Domingo. I didn't know who the hell he was. Never heard of him before. And she said, 'BUHBUHBUH-DE-BUHBUHBUH-DE-BUH-DE-BUH-DE-BUH.' You know? I said, 'Sing me somethin'!…
